{{Top|leg|canon=Vocal emulator implant}}
A '''voice disguiser''', also known as a '''voice scrambler''' or '''voxscrambler''', was a device that modulated the wearer's natural voice to prevent identification of the speaker.

==Features==
A voice disguiser could mask the bearer's [[Gender/Legends|sex]], [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Time/Legends|age]]. The types of voice disguiser ranged in price; they were typically used in conjunction with a disguise or over a communications signal, allowing the bearer to remain incognito.

==History==
Some armor, such as the set that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] wore during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], had voice disguisers built into the helmets.<ref name="tko">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>

When New Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viqi Shesh]] met with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] collaborator [[Reck Desh]] in [[Kuat City]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], she made use of an expensive voice disguiser as she did not wish to divulge her identity.<ref name="aoc1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

Yuuzhan Vong technology provided an organic means by which the disguise of one's voice could be accomplished. Rather than merely render the wearer's original voice unrecognizable, however, the Yuuzhan Vong device would provide a new voice entirely.<ref name="sbs">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>
